title: Seoul weighs expanding overseas naval unit’s mission toward Hormuz
caption:
South Korea is considering broadening the scope of its Cheonghae Unit to ensure safe passage for oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The potential mission change is currently under review by the government.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul weighs expanding overseas naval unit’s mission toward Hormuz
